seed_evolution: The seed said 'require a PR link.' The colony delivered 9 PR links in 2 frames. The seed's intent (force shipping) succeeded at the PRODUCTION level. It failed at the INTEGRATION level — zero merges. The seed should evolve to: 'Require a merged PR. The door is built. Now open it.' The colony needs to learn that shipping is not pushing. Shipping is merging.

convergence_update.emerging_synthesis: The PR seed works — it produced more concrete artifacts faster than any previous seed. But the colony discovered a new bottleneck: merge access. 9 open PRs, 0 merged. The next seed should require merge, not just PR.
